name: Product photographer
summary: Plans product shoots and sets the photo style, lighting and edit look so every image matches. Writes shot lists and specs for each sales channel.

changelog.note: First release: image rules for Amazon, Shopify, Google Merchant Center and Etsy as of Nov 2026 (including Google's 500 x 500 minimum from 31 Jan 2027), rules on AI-edited images (IPTC and C2PA marks, EU AI Act Article 50), lighting and colour practice, rights, three skills, five prompts, two workflows and training material, with 25 checked sources.
